title: Samsung RF260B — Self-diagnostic entry
description: Run self-diagnostic checklist without full test-mode cycle.

steps.title: Enter self-diagnostic
steps.body: Power Freezer + Power Fridge simultaneously 8 s during normal operation. Ding-dong confirms entry; fault LEDs blink 30 s.
